'''New Imperial soldiers''' were the infantry units of the [[New Empire]] under the rule of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]]. The [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of the New Empire welcomed members of all [[Species/Legends|species]], and they wore black armor with dark red markings that differentiated them from the [[Imperial soldier]]s of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="False Emperor" />
